description: One-time private full logical PostgreSQL export, isolated local restore and offline verification. This redacted summary contains no archive location, source connection details, credentials or database rows.
fingerprintMethod: Original same-snapshot full-table row counts and order-independent SHA-256 limb-sum fingerprints matched the restored tables; regression fingerprints, not a cryptographic multiset proof.
metadataScope: Original twelve comparison sections and database metadata matched after exact offline ACL, typed role-setting and database-comment restoration. Original role copies remained NOLOGIN; the separate local verification owner and preload configuration intentionally differed from the managed source.
unchangedPolicies: Recurring application JSON export to Drive retains the latest two verified artifacts; it is not a full PostgreSQL restore image.
The separate fifteen-file uploaded-media snapshot remains one-time, with no recurring media schedule or System Health monitoring.
No backup schedule, retention, budget, cost-control or notification policy was changed by this rehearsal.
remainingLimits: No managed physical/PITR restore, production cutover or whole hosted Supabase service recovery was tested.
Storage object bytes, Google Drive file bytes, external services and role passwords were not restored by this database rehearsal.
Database-to-file byte matching and historical file-version recovery remain unproved.
Separate measured stages do not establish a production recovery-time guarantee.
